description:
**Senior Performance Marketing Expert**

*Digital Marketing \& Branding Agency*

**Job Title:**

Senior Performance Marketing

**Department:**

Performance Marketing / Growth

**Employment Type:**

Full\-Time

**Experience Required:**

4 – 5 Years (Agency Environment Preferred, B2B \+ B2C Mix)

**Reporting To:**

Head of Growth / Creative Director / Founder

**Location:**

On\-Site / Hybrid

**Accounts Managed:**

Multiple Brand \& Client Accounts Simultaneously (B2B and B2C)

**Core Expertise Areas**

* Performance Marketing Strategy \& Media Planning
* B2B \& B2C Paid Campaigns (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Programmatic)
* Funnel Building \& Conversion Rate Optimization
* Analytics, Attribution \& Reporting
* Lead Generation \& Marketing Qualified Lead (MQL) Pipelines
* E\-Commerce \& D2C Performance Growth
* AI\-Based Campaign Optimization \& Automation

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a strategic and hands\-on Senior Performance Marketing Executive who can plan, execute, and optimize paid campaigns across B2B and B2C accounts. This role requires end\-to\-end ownership of performance strategy — from funnel design and media planning to daily execution, testing, and reporting — while directly driving pipeline, revenue, and ROAS outcomes for clients across categories.

The ideal candidate is equally comfortable running high\-intent B2B lead\-gen campaigns and high\-volume B2C e\-commerce campaigns, and can translate business objectives into channel strategy, budget allocation, and measurable growth.

**Key ResponsibilitiesPerformance Strategy \& Planning**

* Build channel strategy and media plans for B2B and B2C accounts based on business goals (leads, ROAS, CAC, LTV).
* Define audience segmentation, funnel stages, and campaign structure across platforms.
* Set and own performance targets (CPL, CAC, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate) per account.
* Present strategy, performance reviews, and growth roadmaps to internal teams and clients.

**Campaign Execution \& Optimization**

* Plan, launch, and manage paid campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, and programmatic platforms.
* Run continuous A/B testing on creatives, copy, audiences, and landing pages.
* Optimize budgets and bids daily/weekly based on performance data.
* Manage B2B lead\-generation funnels (LinkedIn, Google Search, landing pages, CRM handoff).
* Manage B2C/D2C funnels for e\-commerce, app installs, and retail conversion campaigns.

**Analytics, Reporting \& CRO**

* Track and report performance via GA4, Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, and CRM/marketing automation tools.
* Build and maintain dashboards for real\-time campaign visibility.
* Identify funnel drop\-offs and drive Conversion Rate Optimization (landing pages, forms, checkout flow).
* Deliver weekly/monthly performance reports with insights and next\-step recommendations.

**AI \& Automation (Mandatory for Senior Role)**

* Use AI tools (ChatGPT, Copy.ai, AdCreative.ai, Meta Advantage\+, Google Performance Max, etc.) for creative testing and campaign optimization.
* Build automated reporting dashboards and rule\-based bid/budget automation.
* Drive efficiency through AI\-assisted audience research, ad copy generation, and predictive optimization.

**Collaboration \& Delivery**

* Act as the performance marketing SPOC for servicing, creative, and client teams.
* Coordinate with design/content teams to brief high\-performing creative assets.
* Ensure on\-time delivery, budget pacing, and account health across all live campaigns.
* Maintain smooth communication between clients, servicing, and internal stakeholders.

**Required Qualifications**

* 4–5 years of hands\-on performance marketing experience (Agency preferred), with proven exposure to both B2B and B2C accounts.
* Demonstrated experience owning strategy — not execution alone — including media planning and funnel design.
* Strong hands\-on proficiency in Meta Ads Manager, Google Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and GA4\.
* Solid understanding of lead\-gen funnels, MQL/SQL pipelines, and e\-commerce/D2C funnels.
* Working knowledge of CRM/marketing automation tools (HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, or similar).
* Hands\-on experience using AI tools in performance/media workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to translate data into actionable strategy.
* Strong communication and client\-facing presentation skills.

**Positioning Difference**

**Senior:** 

Owns performance strategy, media planning, budget allocation, reporting frameworks, AI\-driven optimization, and cross\-functional delivery — beyond day\-to\-day campaign execution.

title: Social Media Strategist + Copywriter
description:
If your idea of strategy is a content calendar with generic captions, this isn't for you. We need someone who can think like a growth marketer, write like a copywriter, and execute like someone who's tired of overthinking and just wants to ship good work — fast.

You'll own content and copy across multiple client brands (real estate, fintech, edtech, healthcare, interiors), which means you'll switch tone and strategy depending on who you're writing for — without losing your voice.

What You'll Actually Do

**1\. Strategy \& Content That Builds Brands**

* Build content pillars based on audience psychology — not what's "trending on templates"
* Adapt formats and trends fast, across very different industries
* Plan content that's designed to convert, not just get likes

**2\. Copy That Works Everywhere**

* Write for reels, carousels, landing pages, ads, emailers, WhatsApp campaigns, and brochures
* Craft hooks and captions with actual storytelling — not filler text
* Write Meta Ads copy (headlines, primary text, CTAs) and test variants that convert
* Translate boring offerings into copy people actually want to read

**3\. Trend Execution, Not Trend Watching**

* Spot a trend, adapt it for a client's industry, and execute within 24–48 hours
* Shoot, edit, write, publish — you're not waiting on five approvals to move

**4\. Automation \& Funnels (this matters)**

* Set up ManyChat flows for Instagram/Facebook DM automation
* Build comment → DM → lead capture → conversion funnels
* Segment audiences and write follow\-up sequences that don't sound like a bot

**5\. Data, Not Vanity Metrics**

* Track watch time, retention, shares, and conversions — not just likes
* Use data to kill weak hooks and double down on what's working

You're a Strong Fit If You Have

* 2\+ years writing and strategizing for social media (agency experience is a big plus)
* Real, provable experience adapting content across industries — not just one niche
* Hands\-on experience with ManyChat or similar DM automation tools
* A strong grip on hooks, storytelling, and conversion psychology
* The ability to write trust\-led copy for fintech *and* aspirational copy for real estate — in the same week
* A "test it, don't debate it" execution mindset

Bonus Points

* Basic video editing / content shooting skills
* Understanding of paid \+ organic synergy
* Comfortable using AI writing tools without sounding like one
* Experience with Canva/Adobe, scheduling tools, or basic SEO

What We're Done With

* People who only schedule posts and call it strategy
* Writers who sound the same across every client
* Trend\-followers with no strategic reasoning behind the follow
* "I'll get to testing later" energy

What Success Looks Like

* Content and copy that drives DMs, leads, and actual revenue
* A consistent, recognizable voice across every client — even when the industries are nothing alike
* Automated funnels quietly converting engagement while you sleep
* You becoming the person clients specifically ask for

Pay: ₹30,000\.00 \- ₹50,000\.00 per month
